title: Technical Project Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an organized, proactive and technically aware Technical Project Coordinator to support our Software Development divisions. The candidate will coordinate multiple ongoing custom software development projects and in-house product development activities. The primary responsibility will be to monitor project progress, coordinate with developers and QA teams, track deliverables, maintain project documentation and provide consolidated progress reports directly to the senior management.

***Important:*** **This is a coordination and reporting-oriented position, not a software developer or technical team leader position.**

This role is focused on project coordination, execution tracking and reporting. It does not involve technical team leadership, architecture decisions or independent allocation of development resources.

***1. Required Skills & Qualifications:***

**Educational Background:**

● **Graduate in any discipline.**

● B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, BBA or MBA (IT) preferred.

● Relevant IT project coordination experience will be given higher preference than educational qualification alone.

**Professional Experience:**

● **Min 2 years of experience in IT project coordination, software project management, Scrum coordination or related roles.**

● Experience working with software development teams or product teams.

● Practical understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC).

● Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously.

**Technical Knowledge**

● Understanding of frontend and backend development processes.

● Basic knowledge of APIs, databases and application development.

● Understanding of software testing and deployment processes.

● Familiarity with Git, version control and CI/CD concepts.

● Knowledge of Agile, Scrum and Kanban methodologies.

**Tools & Applications**

● Jira / Click Up / Trello or similar project management tools.

● Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets.

● Confluence or similar documentation platforms.

● Basic knowledge of project dashboards and reporting.

**Soft Skills**

● Excellent verbal and written communication.

● Strong organizational and coordination skills.

● Good follow-up and task-tracking abilities.

● Attention to detail.

● Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

● Proactive problem identification and escalation.

● Professional communication with technical teams.

***2. Key Responsibilities:***

**A. Project Planning & Tracking**

● Maintain a centralized record of all ongoing custom development projects and products.

● Track project timelines, milestones, deliverables and deadlines.

● Monitor project progress against planned schedules.

● Maintain project task boards and ensure regular status updates.

● Identify delays, dependencies and potential delivery risks.

● Follow up with relevant team members to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.

**B. Developer & Team Coordination**

● Coordinate with developers, technical leads, QA engineers and other relevant team members.

● Collect regular progress updates from individual developers.

● Track assigned, completed, pending and blocked tasks.

● Monitor developer availability and workload.

● Identify resource dependencies and coordination gaps.

● Facilitate communication between different development teams.

**C. Agile & Sprint Coordination**

● Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups and sprint review meetings.

● Maintain sprint backlogs and task boards.

● Track sprint commitments against actual completion.

● Monitor unresolved tasks and sprint carryovers.

● Coordinate sprint retrospectives and document action items.

● Ensure the team follows agreed project management processes.

**D. Custom Software Project Coordination**

● Track client project requirements, scope, milestones and delivery commitments.

● Maintain project schedules and requirement documentation.

● Coordinate development, testing, UAT and deployment activities.

● Track client feedback, change requests and pending approvals.

● Highlight scope changes and potential timeline impacts to the senior management.

● Maintain project-wise delivery status.

**E. Product Development Coordination**

● Maintain individual product development plans and roadmaps.

● Track feature development, enhancements and bug fixes.

● Coordinate product release schedules.

● Monitor pending product improvements and technical dependencies.

● Maintain release documentation and feature status.

● Track product development progress against planned milestones.

**F. QA & Release Coordination**

● Coordinate with QA teams to track testing activities.

● Monitor open bugs and their resolution status.

● Track critical issues and pending fixes.

● Ensure testing and approval milestones are completed before release.

● Maintain deployment and release checklists.

● Coordinate release readiness updates with technical leads.

**G. Reporting & Documentation**

● Prepare consolidated weekly project status reports for the senior management.

● Maintain project-wise progress dashboards.

● Prepare developer task and workload reports.

● Highlight delayed activities, bottlenecks and delivery risks.

● Maintain meeting minutes and action-item trackers.

● Ensure project documentation is updated and accessible.

***3. Authority & Reporting Structure***

● Reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer.

● Coordinates with existing developers, technical leads and QA teams.

● Responsible for tracking and reporting project execution.

● Does not independently assign technical tasks or change project priorities.

● Does not make architecture, technology or development decisions.

● Escalates project delays, resource conflicts and operational bottlenecks to the senior management.

***4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)***

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and timeliness of project status reporting.
* Timely identification and escalation of project delays.
* Effectiveness of sprint and task tracking.
* Completeness of project documentation.
* Visibility into developer workload and project dependencies.
* Timely follow-up on pending tasks and action items.
* Quality of coordination between development and QA teams.
* Accuracy of project milestone and delivery tracking.

***5. Preferred Candidate Profile***

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

● Have worked in an IT services or software development company.

● Have experience coordinating developers across multiple projects.

● Understand the practical challenges of software development.

● Prefer project management and coordination over hands-on programming.

● Are interested in building a long-term career in IT project management and delivery operations.

We manage our clients’ entire project lifecycle from studies to building assets, operating the assets, and developing efficiencies. Join our team and become part of a community that strives for positive change–providing the best solutions for our clients’ toughest challenges!

**Summary**

The Engagement Manager is responsible for the successful delivery of the engagement’s objectives which includes engagement team leadership and quality completion of the client’s requirements and deliverables in accordance with the approved plans in alignment with the client agreement.

**As the successful candidate, you will:**

* The Engagement Manager is responsible for delivery of the engagement post-award, which
* includes the day-to-day management of the plans, processes, tools, and responsibilities
* associated with delivering the engagement to the client’s and Hatch’s defined expectations. This is achieved by:
* Being involved in the pursuit phase as early as practical.
* Establishing appropriate and approved management plans.
* Managing the engagement delivery in accordance with the approved management plans.
* Leading the delivery team and providing support, guidance and coaching as required.
* Ensuring the completion of engagement reviews and monthly reporting in support of the
* successful delivery of the engagement for the client and Hatch.

This position description should be read in conjunction with the Project Management Discipline Guide , which provides the overall context for the Engagement Manager’s accountabilities and responsibilities.

Pursuit Stage

* During each phase of the Engagement Lifecycle from the time the Engagement Manager is appointed, the responsibilities of the role include:
* Winning Work Phase
* Support the winning work efforts or proposal process as required.
* Participate in Prime Contract discussions and negotiations as required.
* Initiation and Transition Phase
* Assist the Delivery Sponsor in completing the engagement transition from the Pursuit Team to the Delivery Team.
* Open the engagement in iPas PM with the Business Sponsor’s agreement.
* Establish appropriate systems including appropriate people, processes and tools are in place to manage the engagement.
* Establish original baselines and delivery, functional and performance requirements,
* including identifying risks, performance metrics and KPIs to achieve the client and Hatch standards.

Delivery Stage

* Planning and Set-Up Phase
* Establish and set-up engagement management plans including review and approval from the Delivery Sponsor of the control baselines that include sufficient provision for risk in accordance with Hatch standards.
* Incorporate quality management requirements into the management plans consistent with the Hatch Integrated Management Systems (HIMS).
* Prepare an engagement staffing plan and ensure regional discipline leadership are aware of the requirements.
* Establish regular communications the Client representative.
* Conduct the Delivery Team and Client Kick-off Meetings.
* Provide the Client with the engagement work plans as appropriate and ensure there is common understanding.
* Create the initial Project Contract Change Request (PCCR) which may include a Variation
* Order (VO) or Project Change Notice or Request (PCN, PCR). Include a Gap Analysis and receive client approval to capture changes from agreed baseline.
* Obtain approval of changes to determine the Current Baseline and Work Plans (Establish Current Baselines if there are changes from Original Baselines).
* Schedule and participate in the set-up review with the Delivery Sponsor. Include an
* Independent Reviewer if necessary, based on scope and governance level

Execution and Control Phase

* Manage the engagement in accordance with the approved management plans.
* Deliver engagement requirements and activities in accordance with the appropriate Client and Hatch standards and agreement commitments.
* Establish suitable change management practices in alignment with Hatch standards and ensure that the approved work plans are being maintained.
* Conduct appropriate quality and compliance reviews of the scope requirements including capital feasibility estimates, CAPEX or OPEX.
* Timely submission appropriate progress, trending and forecasting reporting and performance reports in accordance with the client requirements and Hatch standards.
* Approval of all timesheet hours associated with the engagement for time allocated to the client’s project.
* Participate in Monthly Performance Reviews (MPR) in accordance with the Hatch guidelines and processes.
* Raise and escalate all engagement risks, issues, and causes of concern.
* Perform timely change management throughout engagement lifecycle including adherence to client and Hatch approval requirements.
* Participate in any required engagement reviews including functional, delivery or performance reviews (i.e., capital feasibility estimates, CAPEX or OPEX) as outlined in Hatch process guides and standards.
* Assign and manage all risk mitigations and corrective actions.
* Manage all aspects of the Hatch prime contract and any subcontracts to Hatch, including invoice payment.
* Ensure the various approvals including invoicing, timesheets, PCN's, claims etc. are in alignment with delivery and Hatch requirements.
* Proactively participate in any dispute resolutions with Client, if required.
* Support and coach less experienced Delivery Team staff where appropriate.
* Close-out and Improvement Phase
* Solicit and record Client feedback at completion of the engagement.
* Confirm and document the engagement delivery is complete and achieve the client and Hatch’s requirements.
* Manage suitable Engagement administrative close-out, including final payments and Write[1]up/down reporting as required.
* Identify and record progressive learnings in the QMS database.
* Identify and record opportunities for continuous improvement, include benchmarking.

**You bring to the role:**

**Qualifications Experience**

* University degree in Engineering, Architecture, Business or equivalent
* Demonstrated working knowledge of engineering, commercial management, project controls, risk management, construction management, procurement, operational readiness, project closeout and project finance
* Strong commercial and business development expertise
* Working knowledge of industry standards and practices
* Strong customer /client focus

**Experience**

Small and Medium engagements:

* At least five years’ experience in cross-functional leadership roles
* At least five years’ experience managing multi-discipline consulting/ engineering/construction projects
* At least five years’ experience coordinating, organizing and planning of community and industrial relations

Large and Major engagements:

* At least fifteen years’ experience in cross-functional leadership roles including program management, integration management, and operational readiness
* At least fifteen years’ experience managing multi-discipline consulting/ engineering/construction projects or programs in an alternative contract environment including a contractor delivery or mega-project environment. Example projects include EPC, DB, DBO, BOO, P3/PPP, AFP, DBFOM
* At least fifteen years’ experience coordinating, organizing and planning of community and industrial relations

Why join us?

* Work with great people to make a difference
* Collaborate on exciting projects to develop innovative solutions
* Top employer

What we offer you?

* Flexible work environment
* Long term career development
* Think globally, work locally

Don't meet every single requirement? You don't need to. At Hatch, we are building a diverse, inclusive workplace that fosters innovation. If you're interested in this role, we encourage you to apply even if your past experiences don't perfectly align with the skills we've listed.

We're committed to fostering a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate and serve. * Ensure adherence to product quality standards, process specifications, and customer requirements.
* Establish and monitor quality control systems and corrective and preventive action plans.
* Promote a strong safety culture across projects, plant operations, and contractor activities.

* Monitor inventory levels, stock ageing, material availability, and working capital tied up in inventory.
* Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, Production, Finance, and Logistics teams to meet customer delivery commitments.

* Coordinate with senior management on strategic planning, capital expenditure, project priorities, procurement strategies, international trade, manpower planning, and operational challenges.
